subject: english
prompt:
Read: "The science club tested two paper planes. Plane A flew farther, but Plane B stayed in the air longer. The club recorded both results instead of naming one plane the winner.
Why did the club record both results?"

options.text: Each plane performed better in a different way.
Both planes were made of metal.
The club forgot to measure distance.

answer.explanation: The text gives two different measures, so each plane had a different strength.
